definitions.tip_center: Mean of unique actual CAD vertices in the final0.1mm along body-local+Y; representative distal center, not an asserted material surface point.
definitions.distal_surface: All unique actual jaw mesh vertices plus actual triangle centroids in the final1mm along CAD+Y. Minimum sampled distance is not an exact mesh-mesh collision distance.
definitions.closest_distance: Euclidean distance to the closest point on the complete actual phantom triangle surface, including groove walls and bottom.
definitions.closest_face_normal_projection: Dot(sample-minus-closest-point, oriented nearest triangle normal); a local sign diagnostic, not a certified global inside/outside classification.
definitions.vertical_clearance: Signed world-Z height above the first actual phantom surface hit by a downward ray from0.2m above the sample; NaN where no surface lies below that XY.
definitions.base_normal_clearance: Same topmost-surface comparison along the unchanged native phantom base normal instead of worldZ.
definitions.table_height: Signed distance from the actual USD table top; phantom displacement relative to that plane is independently fitted.
